conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm 56 years old, male, and I've been having trouble swallowing for the past four to five weeks. It feels like something is always stuck in my throat, especially when I eat solid foods like a sandwich. It's not too bad most of the time, but it does bother me and sometimes feels a little painful.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you experienced any weight loss, regurgitation, or pain in the chest or throat associated with your dysphagia? Have you been evaluated for this symptom before, and if so, what were the findings or treatments?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't lost any weight, and I don't have any chest or throat pain with it. I haven't been evaluated for this before, so I don't have any findings or treatments to report.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you experienced any regurgitation, heartburn, or odynophagia? Additionally, are there any risk factors for esophageal or pharyngeal disorders, such as a history of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), smoking, alcohol use, or prior radiation therapy to the neck or chest?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't had any regurgitation or heartburn, and I don't have any pain when swallowing. I don't smoke or drink alcohol, and I've never had radiation therapy to my neck or chest. I don't have a history of GERD either.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you noticed any changes in your voice, such as hoarseness or difficulty speaking, or any difficulty breathing? Have you had any recent upper respiratory infections or throat irritation?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't noticed any changes in my voice or any difficulty breathing. I haven't had any recent upper respiratory infections or throat irritation either.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you experienced any difficulty with swallowing liquids, or have you noticed any changes in your ability to eat or drink over the past few weeks?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I don't have any difficulty swallowing liquids. It's mostly when I eat solid foods, like a sandwich, that I feel like something is stuck in my throat. I haven't noticed any changes in my ability to drink, just sometimes I have to wash down a bite of food to get it to go down.
